value.rationale: A sign-parity statistic on a published natural infinite representation family measures cancellation concealed by total counts. The result gives complete regular-language recognition, exact Fibonacci frequencies at every binary length, and a sharp density exponent, each useful for structured sign-weighted binary enumeration rather than an arbitrary finite count.
